title: Signature Sunrise Chair
concept: Dialysis chairs positioned for sunrise views, with warm blankets and unhurried starts — treatment beginning with beauty. The long hours, softened. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on fluorescent rows with dawn-facing comfort.
patient_flow: Patients with end-stage kidney disease dialyze on fixed schedules — typically Monday-Wednesday-Friday — arriving, weighing in, and connecting to machines for 3 to 4 hours. Nurses monitor pressures, symptoms, and labs each run. Dietitians and social workers see patients chairside; transplant evaluation runs in parallel for eligible candidates.
code_demo:
# Signature Sunrise Chair — Signature design prototype
def ktv_adequacy(pre_bun, post_bun, hours, uf_liters, weight_kg):
    """Single-pool Kt/V estimator (Daugirdas simplified). Target >= 1.2."""
    r = post_bun / pre_bun
    ktv = -__import__('math').log(r - 0.008 * hours) + (4 - 3.5 * r) * (uf_liters / weight_kg)
    return f"Kt/V {ktv:.2f} -> {'ADEQUATE (>=1.2)' if ktv >= 1.2 else 'INADEQUATE - review prescription'}"
print(ktv_adequacy(70, 22, 4, 2.5, 70))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
